strongest_angle: Examine the newly deciphered red travel diary of Harry Houdini spanning 1897 to 1899, covering his rise from dime-store vaudeville to international stardom alongside Bess Houdini, from the collection of Dr. Bruce Averbook.

key_facts.fact: Harry Houdini's travel diary from 1897 to 1899 was published in a book titled Escaping Obscurity: The Travel Diary of Harry Houdini, 1897-1899.
Dr. Bruce Averbook provided the earliest known diary of Harry Houdini from his collection to be reproduced in its entirety for the public.
key_facts.source_name: The Averbook Magic Art Museum & Library

key_facts.fact: Nina Strochlic reported in National Geographic in October 2026 on the little red book containing Harry Houdini's recently deciphered notes charting his rise as a performer.
John Cox gave a presentation on Harry Houdini's diary during the General Session at MAGIC Live! on a Monday.
